# Dorek International Enterprises LLP

> Dorek International Enterprises LLP is a diversified corporate enterprise delivering turnkey engineering, commercial solar energy, smart retail networks, and enterprise software systems.

## Primary Sections
- [Home](https://dorek.in/): Official corporate landing portal
- [About Us](https://dorek.in/about): Corporate overview, leadership, timeline and CSR
- [Businesses](https://dorek.in/businesses): Engineering, Solar, Doorcarts Smart Retail, Enterprise Software
- [Careers](https://dorek.in/careers): Career openings and talent acquisition
- [Contact](https://dorek.in/contact): Headquarters contact and partnership inquiries
